clips.title: The story
paras: Furen's Notes carry his discoveries in metallurgy and armorsmithing from Stormwind to Alliance craftsmen. After forging protective gear for veteran warriors, Furen Longbeard sends copies to help fellow smiths refine their work.

In Stormwind's Dwarven District, Furen Longbeard forges specialized armaments for warriors and records the methods and discoveries he makes along the way. Dwarven metalworking keeps changing, so he makes several copies for other smiths to use and build upon. His notes describe practical ways to temper, reinforce, and shape armor against deadly blows.

Furen sends copies to trusted contacts in the Alliance's crafting networks. Grimand Elmore may scoff at a fellow smith he claims to have taught, but the notes still hold useful insights. Copies cross the Great Sea to night elven craftsmen, including Mathiel on Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace. Shared needs in battle bring their different traditions into contact.
